architecture.body: Frozen full-country-tree encoder; complete hierarchy and features shared
architecture.conditional_triple: H051 fixed alpha1 at genuine cut changes, basis leaf, broadcast BC cells; Pi_BC Pi_AB
architecture.first_order: H051 fixed alpha0 at genuine cut changes, basis leaf, broadcast BC cells; Pi_B in exact arithmetic

fixed_persistence_prior.initial_ranks: Monotone transformation preserves same-FP32 persistence ranks mathematically; FP32/log/softmax/nativeFP64 tie differences require root qualification
fixed_persistence_prior.missing_or_observed_zero_row: Uniform all255 probabilities from equal positive smoothing
fixed_persistence_prior.selection: Fixed before any new-model evaluation; not tuned

architecture.readout: log(latest_observed_outgoing_profile +1e-8) plus shared128->64->255 learned residual; final residual layer initialized zero
architecture.temporal: Leafwise GRUCell64; all arms retain [255,64] state allocation; shared 128->64->255 readout
architecture.tree_only: Zero carry each year; current graph only. GRU weight_hh is structurally unused

data.forecast_rule: At year tau use only observed edge years strictly less than tau; predict all255sources, then release complete edges at tau. No within-year row-order information.
data.input_residency: All30 causal graphs/schedules/plans and23 TRAIN targets transferred once to authorized device before repeated epochs
data.profile: Frozen latest observed outgoing row, never-observed/zero/staleness, strictly past complete edge years

evaluation.TEST_release: Explicit root action after frozen prediction seal and confirmation decision; source driver never evaluates automatically
evaluation.additional_contrast: first_order minus tree_only, and each model minus each frozen native baseline
evaluation.aggregation: Equal queried countries within year; equal years within split
evaluation.known_baseline_context: Already-known strong native H052 persistence motivated preserving its profile as a common residual prior; no new-model TEST result used
evaluation.primary_mechanism_contrast: conditional_triple minus first_order, paired target years within seed17; descriptive utility only
evaluation.scores: FP32 softmax destination probabilities; CPU raw FP64 target weights for exact native metric
evaluation.support: Same official target-source rows as H052; all255outputs sealed before held-out source selection
evaluation.uncertainty: Report descriptive sample SD over serially dependent years; seed17 alone cannot estimate optimizer-seed variation

future_hypotheses.status: Not primary, not implemented as selectable campaign arms, no selection from current TEST

later_confirmation.decision: Root may decide using initial TRAIN/VAL utility while TEST remains closed; run all paired arms unchanged, never select on TEST
later_confirmation.uncertainty: Additional optimizer seeds do not create independent target years

metric.aggregation: Mean queried nations within each target year, then equal mean target years per split
metric.name: NDCG@10
metric.uncertainty: Sample SD across target years, descriptive serially dependent periods, not optimizer seeds

objective: Initial incremental residual-plus-transport architecture utility diagnostic; residual prior itself is not a new contribution

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.order: Chronological23years; arithmetic mean of equal-country soft cross entropy within each year, equal years, one optimizer update

primary_campaign.model_selection: Frozen final epoch100; no early stopping/checkpoint hunt/hyperparameter search/arm selection

supervised_adaptation.explanation: TRAIN labels1987..2009 read before supervised fitting; H052 unsupervised baseline sealed all years before any label parse
supervised_adaptation.heldout: No VAL/TEST target callback in trainer; seal every arm/all255countries before split-specific label/source selection
supervised_adaptation.past_heldout_observations: At later forecast years earlier VAL/TEST edge observations are legitimate released history, as in H052; no heldout parameter updates
supervised_adaptation.target_reader: Root must supply genuine TRAIN-only target capability; filtering an already parsed held-out target object is not the trainer contract

temporal_semantics.bootstrap: First year zero state; first distinct cut change uses a=b=initial cut, so memory transports agree
temporal_semantics.cut_episodes: Canonical country co-membership, anonymous labels; two last DISTINCT cuts
temporal_semantics.final_replay: Frozen final weights replay1987..2016; discard in-sample TRAIN outputs, seal2010..2016 outputs
temporal_semantics.gradient: Full 23-year TRAIN BPTT per epoch, no detach/truncation/warmstart
temporal_semantics.holds: Unchanged-cut annual holds retain full leaf state and each get one GRU update with current causal forcing; no extra projection
temporal_semantics.interval: One discrete calendar year, no genomic clock/units or artificial duration adaptation
temporal_semantics.reset: State zero at1987 at every epoch and every final-weight replay
